calls.title: Confirm Kinesiology's 627 where the descriptions and TOP both agree?
calls.text: Open Asks Sheet 174 card 1: the seed re-check reads course descriptions (88% right held out at a clear margin) with TOP beside them. Of 12,504 seed cards, 1,964 have both signals; in Kinesiology 627, and 8 go to a curator.
calls.no_reply: Every seed card stays capped at 0.79; nothing in the catalog changes.

calls.title: Confirm the next five disciplines where the descriptions and TOP both agree?
calls.text: Open Asks Sheet 176 card 1 (re-asked from Sheet 175): Music 250, Fire Technology 169, Mathematics 128, Child Development/ECE 107 and English 99 cards, by the same two signals that confirmed Kinesiology's 627. Answer five, all, one or later.
calls.no_reply: The five disciplines' seed cards stay capped at 0.79; nothing in the catalog changes.

answer.words: Confirm the five (Sheet 175 card 1); applied S621, 753 cards

next_step.title: Confirm the next five disciplines, if Sam agrees
next_step.text: Sheet 175 asks whether Music, Fire Technology, Mathematics, Child Development/ECE and English are confirmed where the descriptions and TOP both agree; it is also the Docket's first case in the Commons (#commons/case/2026-11-09-ccr-next-five). On his word kb/_ccr_seed_confirm_apply.py runs per discipline with its --expect count.

changes.text: Kinesiology's 627 seed cards are confirmed by description and TOP, on Sam's confirm (Open Asks Sheet 174); the 8 that disagree are the Courses List's Discipline in doubt job.
The seed re-check dry run reads two second signals on the 14,523 capped seed disciplines: course descriptions, as Sam asked on Sheet 173, and TOP beside them (#2940).

Moreno Valley's HES 1 claim on C-ID HIST 150 held, and West Los Angeles's ADDICST 1 claim on PH 103: each course joins the identity its sister colleges give it; a daily audit lists new claims of this kind (#2862, open).
A course's panel in the Courses List shows its common course and, for a signed-in reviewer, Rename, Set the discipline and Confirm, carried from the Common Course Reference tab (#2776).
The sign-in link lands in the shared session file and returns to the view it was asked from (#2775); the old tab had landed every sign-in.
The Course page and the Commons card count cards a person has confirmed in SkyView beside ready: 812 of 27,581 (#2726).
The Courses List keeps the row you rule on in view and marked, with its band; the ruling's save, the edits and Open in SkyView each have their own line (#3004).
